required_evidence.event_impacts: one exact impact and ablation record per event
required_evidence.post_event_solution: same source solver result for P1 after the state overlay
required_evidence.target_selection: P1 identity fixed before authoring and replaying the event chain
required_evidence.dependency_difference: private P0/P1 dependency footprints and changed owned fields
required_evidence.constraint_transition: C0, legal owned-state deltas, and resulting C1
required_evidence.forward_verification: exact identity match between fixed P1 and the forward solver result
required_evidence.public_observation_contract: owning App/tool path without private identifiers
